say: ChatGPT's inhale tilts its head forward, grows its logo, and pulls everything in front of it into a tornado.
Stack Overflow's blocks spin and shred into confetti at the mouth, and Claude's rods turn to face it and stretch thin, like spaghetti.
Claude's dots are pulled out of formation, and each one circles the mouth once before it goes in.
A beam fired into the tornado ends at the mouth instead of landing, and every block that feeds it adds context.
Even a condescending correction comes apart, and its words fly out of the speech bubble one by one.
With half its context full, ChatGPT can compact everyone in front of it, and they grow back slowly as they land hits.
